items.title: Kuva Space Spots Illegal Poppy Farms from Orbit
items.summary: Finnish hyperspectral satellite operator Kuva Space released data today from a pilot program that demonstrated its ability to monitor illegal crop farming from space. The study used Kuva’s Hyperfield-1 satellites to analyze an area in Afghanistan’s Helmand Province. It combined data from the EU’s Copernicus Sentinel-2 sats with 363 hyperspectral images gathered by Hyperfield to identify 8,835 potential poppy fields in a survey of ~250,000 agricultural plots in the area.
